name: moodboard
description: Turn a curated Pinterest mirror into a portable design brief. Semantic-searches a wiki-MCP-indexed pin shadow across all boards, surfaces 3 candidates with thumbnail previews, lets you pick/reject/refine, then extracts design DNA (palette, type, texture, composition, motion, anti-patterns) and writes a tool-agnostic MOODBOARD.md (with W3C-shaped tokens) for design-consultation, design-shotgun, frontend builders, or image-gen. The brief is the durable artifact. Local-only - depends on ~/wiki/pinterest/ and the wiki MCP.
